# bg-remove.com - AI Background Remover

This is a free online tool to instantly remove backgrounds from images and videos.
We use advanced local AI models (running entirely in the browser via WebGL/WASM) to ensure 100% privacy, security, and extremely fast performance. No data is ever uploaded to external servers.

## Key Features
- High-quality image background removal
- Video background removal (mp4, webm, etc.)
- 100% private (processed on-device)
- Completely free to use

## Tools
We offer specialized landing pages for various use-cases:
- Transparent PNG Maker
- Remove Background from JPG/JPEG
- Extract Images from PDF
- GIF Background Remover
- Logo Background Remover
- Signature Background Remover
- Change Backgrounds
- Passport Photo Maker
- AI Background Generator

## Technical Architecture
- Framework: Next.js (App Router)
- AI Pipeline: ONNX Runtime Web, Transformers.js
- Styling: Vanilla CSS

No API keys are required for the client-side processing. All computation happens locally, making it infinitely scalable at zero server cost.
